summary: Resin Toll Script / Merchant Claim, Baffle control / Smother Hunter, and marked plates / Plate Snare mostly align with doctrine: short-term safety now, organism notices repetition, schedules counters. Voice is largely compliant and first-person. Biggest gaps: a few generic shop/menu phrases, occasional visible speaker label metadata (“speaker”: "Her") risks UI leak, and some events lack explicit Chorus check-ins. Merchant needs more predatory mediation tone. Plate Snare and Smother Hunter correctly express the organism pushing habits into traps; Resin Toll ties to Claim well, but “Browse wares” undercuts threat. Add clearer delayed-consequence flags in-text and ensure refusal always carries debt or attention. Overall solid first pass; tighten Chorus discipline and exchange cadence language.
